AREAS.name: Pre-Weigh
competencies: Identifies every ingredient by label, code and appearance.
Reads the current recipe/batch sheet correctly, including units and version.
Operates, zeroes and tares scales; performs the daily scale check.
Weighs within the tolerance stated on the batch sheet.
Records every ingredient lot used against the batch.
Segregates allergens, uses dedicated tools, prevents cross-contact.
Stages weighed kits in the right place and order for mixing.
Scans ingredients and kits; resolves scan errors correctly.
Reconciles usage against the work order and reports variances.
Completes records in real time with good documentation practices.
Follows GMPs and food safety rules in the weigh area.
Stops, isolates and escalates wrong or suspect ingredients.
Labels every container with contents, lot, date and allergen status.
Moves materials safely and keeps them identified.
Confirms the work order matches the recipe before starting.

AREAS.name: Mixing
AREAS.description: Normal production method is AUTO operation unless an approved procedure explicitly authorizes another mode.
competencies: Performs pre-start checks and starts the mixer per the approved procedure.
Runs the mixer in AUTO, the standard production mode.
Selects and confirms the correct recipe on the HMI.
Confirms automatic and hand-added ingredients are dosed correctly.
Verifies mix times match the recipe.
Verifies mix speeds match the recipe.
Checks and records dough temperature; reacts to out-of-range results.
Checks batch against the quality standard before release.
Navigates HMI screens for recipes, status and alarms.
Identifies each alarm and what it means.
Responds to alarms per procedure without bypassing safeguards or interlocks.
Completes batch records accurately and on time.
Performs and documents allergen changeover and verification.
Cleans the mixer per the sanitation procedure, using lockout/tagout where required.
Shuts down the mixer safely per procedure.
Stops and escalates abnormal conditions to the lead or supervisor.
Follows approved troubleshooting procedures. Manual mode only when authorized, trained and covered by an approved procedure; never bypasses interlocks or lockout/tagout.

AREAS.name: Blending
competencies: Confirms recipe and version before blending.
Adds ingredients in the specified order.
Sets up blending equipment per procedure.
Verifies total batch weight within tolerance.
Monitors blend time against the specification.
Transfers blended material without loss or contamination.
Performs consistency checks and records results.
Records lots and links them to the blend batch.
Cleans blending equipment per the sanitation procedure.

AREAS.name: Food Safety & GMP
AREAS.description: Mandatory food safety training for all production roles.
competencies: Follows GMP, hygiene and PPE rules.
Knows plant allergens and cross-contact controls.
Knows the CCPs in their area and the response to a deviation.
Applies glass, brittle plastic and tool control rules.
Tags and isolates suspect product; never releases without QA.

AREAS.name: Safety
AREAS.description: Mandatory safety training for all production roles.
competencies: Knows authorized vs affected roles; never removes another person's lock.
Knows E-stop locations; never bypasses guards or interlocks.
Reads labels and SDS; uses the right PPE.
Uses cold PPE, warm-up breaks and freezer door releases.
Knows alarms, evacuation routes and muster points.
